```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

## Task 1

```{r Questions 1 and 2}
hosts_10_plus = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "listing_count") |>
  dplyr::filter(listing_count >= 10)
hosts_10_plus

host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "listing_count")

listings_with_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

chicago_percent = listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    percent = mean(listing_count >= 10) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(percent)

round(chicago_percent, 1)
```

# Task 2

```{r Question 3}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Columbus",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |>
  dplyr::group_by(neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    listings = dplyr::n(),
    median_price = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(listings >= 20) |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price)
```
## Task 3

```{r Question 4}
listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  )
```

## Task 4

```{r Question 5}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    percent = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10], na.rm = TRUE) /
              sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(percent = round(percent, 1))
```

## Task 5

```{r Question 6 and 7}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    availability |>
      dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10"),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    share = mean(
      nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(share)
```

# Task 6

```{r Question 8 and 9}
twin_reviews = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(reviews, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_reviews = sum(number_of_reviews, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

busiest_month = twin_reviews |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews)) |>
  dplyr::slice(1)

review_ratio = max(twin_reviews$total_reviews) /
               min(twin_reviews$total_reviews)

busiest_month
round(review_ratio, 2)
```

## Task 8

```{r Question 10}
listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id") |>
  nrow()
```

## Task 7

```{r Question 11}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = host_is_superhost,
    values_from = median_price
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    premium = t - f
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(city, premium) |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(city, c("Chicago", "Columbus", "Twin Cities")))
```
